findings.summary: A failed multi-source P1 attempt partially promotes earlier sources instead of preserving attempt atomicity.
findings.detail: _register_sources commits each request directly to the case inside the loop. If a later request fails validation, run_attempts records P1 unavailable after three retries but the earlier source, raw bytes, and receipt remain promoted. The probe supplied a valid CSV followed by an unsupported .txt and ended status=unavailable, phase=P1, attempts.P1=3 while data/sources.json and data/raw/good/good.csv already contained the first source. Stage or prevalidate the complete registration batch and promote it atomically, with a public regression test asserting no partial source mutation on a later-item failure.

findings.summary: Future Gate A/Gate B decisions are carried through the resolver loop and can bypass required human turn boundaries.
findings.detail: normalize_inputs captures every supplied gate decision once, and lines 119-126 reuse that same set after every freshly sealed phase. A gate_a value supplied before P3 completion therefore makes P4 immediately ready; a gate_b value supplied before P6 completion likewise makes P7 immediately ready. The resolver probe returned ready owners approve-and-detect and accept-and-report when both future decisions were pre-supplied. Gate decisions must only be consumable when their gate is the invocation's current human stop; add a public test proving future gate inputs cannot cross either turn.

findings.summary: README projection deletes journalist-authored content that exactly matches the legacy Outputs block.
findings.detail: After removing the marked block, line 37 globally replaces every exact _OUTPUTS occurrence with an empty string. A probe with a journalist-authored Outputs section plus Notes returned journalist_outputs_preserved=false; only Notes survived. Bound legacy migration to the single Anomaly-owned location/marker and add preservation coverage for generated-looking journalist content, not only an unrelated trailing section.

findings.summary: Public resume/read paths do not perform the required whole-case no-symlink scan.
findings.detail: resume_case calls only _load_case; inspect_case reaches the same loader. Domain public writers such as register_local_source call resume_case and validate selected documents, not the whole tree. A probe added an unrelated nested symlink and resume_case accepted the case. Put the whole-case boundary on every public resume/read/write entry (preferably the shared owning boundary) and test direct resume/inspect plus representative direct writes, not only run_workflow.

findings.summary: Reviewer independence can be bypassed with canonically equivalent Unicode identities.
findings.detail: Both Gate A/reviewer and reviewer/Gate B comparisons use casefold() only at lines 121-123 and 134-136. The probe showed composed 'Réviewer' and decomposed 'Réviewer' compare unequal with casefold but equal under the project's canonical_key, allowing the same logical identity through both separation checks. Validate identities under the portable policy or compare canonical_key values; add both Gate A and Gate B canonical-equivalence tests.

findings.summary: The AC3 retry tests no longer verify credential-redacted failure evidence.
findings.detail: The retained tests assert three attempts and relative attempt paths but inject no secret and inspect neither failure.json nor blocked_reason for redaction. The deleted WorkflowRunner test was the only attempt-level redaction assertion. Because persisted failure evidence is consumer-observable and explicitly required, a focused public retry test is owed; this is not a change-detector test.

findings.summary: The deleted invalidation matrix left most authoritative identity classes without earliest-suffix coverage.
findings.detail: Current public tests cover prepared change, source replacement, and Gate B mutation, but no longer cover detector identity, detector parameters/recommendation, Gate A receipt, draft, replay, or review mutations. Those behaviors remain in IDENTITY_PHASES and were not removed from production, so deleting their assertions without replacement violates the remove rule and AC4's earliest-invalidation floor. Restore focused resolution/state tests for every identity-to-earliest-phase mapping without recreating the synthetic P0-P7 handler composition.
